description: Free SFX libraries, packs and ambience for video, games, podcasts and streams.
description_zh: 面向视频、游戏、播客与直播的免费音效库、音效包与氛围音。

entries.name: Freesound
entries.description: Collaborative database of sounds under CC0 and CC-BY licenses.
entries.description_zh: 以 CC0 与 CC-BY 许可为主的大型协作声音数据库。
entries.notes: Filter by license; CC-BY sounds need credit in your description.
entries.notes_zh: 按许可证筛选；CC-BY 声音需在简介中署名。

entries.name: ZapSplat
entries.description: 100,000+ free sound effects; free tier works with attribution.
entries.description_zh: 10 万+ 免费音效；免费档需署名。
entries.notes: Gold membership removes attribution and raises quality limits.
entries.notes_zh: Gold 会员可免署名并提高下载质量上限。

entries.name: Pixabay Sound Effects
entries.description: Royalty-free sound effects library from Pixabay.

entries.name: Mixkit Sound Effects
entries.description: Free SFX for videos, games and streams from Envato's Mixkit.
entries.description_zh: Envato Mixkit 的免费音效，适用于视频、游戏与直播。

entries.name: BBC Sound Effects
entries.description: 33,000+ sounds from the historic BBC archive.
entries.description_zh: BBC 历史档案中的 33,000+ 声音。
entries.notes: NOT free for commercial or monetized content; great for learning and research.
entries.notes_zh: 不可用于商业或已货币化内容；适合学习与研究。

entries.name: Sonniss GDC Audio Bundles
entries.description: Multi-gigabyte professional game audio packs released free every year.
entries.description_zh: 每年免费发放的数 GB 专业游戏音频包。

entries.name: Orange Free Sounds
entries.description: Large mixed library of free sounds, loops and ringtones.
entries.description_zh: 大型混合免费声音、循环与铃声库。

entries.name: SoundBible
entries.description: Simple, no-frills free sound effect downloads.
entries.description_zh: 简单直接的免费音效下载站。

entries.name: Freesfx.co.uk
entries.description: Free sound effects usable with a credit.
entries.description_zh: 免费音效，使用时需署名。
entries.notes: Free for commercial and broadcast use, but the credit must include the freesfx.co.uk URL.
entries.notes_zh: 可用于商业与广播制作，但署名中必须包含 freesfx.co.uk 网址。

entries.name: Kenney Audio
entries.description: CC0 audio packs (UI, sci-fi, RPG) from the prolific Kenney library.
entries.description_zh: 高产素材库 Kenney 的 CC0 音频包（UI、科幻、RPG）。

entries.name: Tabletop Audio
entries.description: Ambience loops for tabletop RPG sessions, streams and podcasts.
entries.description_zh: 适合跑团、直播与播客的氛围循环音。
entries.notes: NonCommercial only: fine for personal and non-monetized use.
entries.notes_zh: 仅限非商业：可用于个人及未货币化内容。

entries.name: SFXMint
entries.description: Free CC0 game and UI sound effects in WAV/MP3; AI-generated or procedurally synthesized.
entries.description_zh: 免费 CC0 游戏与 UI 音效库，提供 WAV/MP3 下载；素材由 AI 生成或程序合成。
entries.notes: Library sounds are CC0; the separate AI generation feature has its own pricing — preview sounds before shipping.
entries.notes_zh: 站内音效素材均为 CC0；独立的 AI 生成功能另行计费——发布前请先试听确认。

entries.name: Soundza
entries.description: Free royalty-free sound effects, music loops and ambience in WAV/MP3; no attribution, commercial use allowed.
entries.description_zh: 免费音效、音乐循环与环境音库（WAV/MP3）；免署名、可商用。
entries.notes: Downloads need a free account after the first three. May not redistribute sounds as standalone files, resell them, or use them to train AI models.
entries.notes_zh: 前 3 个下载免注册，之后需免费账号；不得把音效作为独立文件再分发、转售，或用于训练 AI 模型。

entries.name: 99Sounds
entries.description: Free royalty-free sound packs and plugins; personal and commercial use, credit not required.
entries.description_zh: 免费免版税音效包与插件；个人与商业项目可用，无需署名。
entries.notes: License page allows unlimited commercial use without credit, but the files may not be resold or redistributed on their own, nor used to build white-noise or sleep-sound apps.
entries.notes_zh: 许可页允许不限量商用且免署名；但不得单独转售或再分发这些音频文件，也不得用其素材制作白噪音或助眠类 App。

entries.name: DailySounds
entries.description: Free sound effects (UI, hits, explosions, sci-fi, footsteps, ambience, meme clips); preview in browser, download MP3/WAV/OGG. Commercial use, no credit.
entries.description_zh: 免费音效库，涵盖 UI、打击、爆炸、科幻、脚步、氛围与梗类片段；可在线试听并下载 MP3/WAV/OGG，可商用、免署名。
entries.notes: Sign-up unknown: downloads unverified from a clean environment. Clips naming a film, brand or celebrity are fan-made/meme-style; judge commercial use yourself. No resale, redistribution or Content ID.
entries.notes_zh: 站点称无需注册，但本次未能从干净环境确认下载流程，故记为未知（unknown）。部分音效标题涉及影视、品牌或名人，许可称其为粉丝/梗类创作，商用是否合适需自行判断。禁止转售、再分发原始文件及注册 Content ID。
